assessment_summary: Line 0024 claims that the edge u -> v is NOT in the capacity c(S \cap T', T \cap S') because it goes from S \cap T' to T \cap S'. This is a direct contradiction: the capacity of a cut from a set A to a set B exactly includes the capacities of edges going from A to B. Therefore, the edge u -> v is actually included in c(S \cap T', T \cap S'), making the statement in line 0024 false.
